# Arcane Archer (Fighter) Subclass Skill

Use this skill whenever a Fighter character is, or is planned to become, an **Arcane Archer**, and their sheet, features, or rules behaviour need authoritative grounding.

## Source & Status

- **Source:** *Unearthed Arcana 2025: Arcane Subclasses* (WotC playtest material, ©2025 Wizards of the Coast).
- **Ruleset:** 2024 Player's Handbook.
- **Status:** ⚠️ **Playtest — not official content.** Power level and numbers may change before publication, and it is not legal for organised play.

> Always label Arcane Archer content on a sheet as **Playtest (UA 2025)** so players know it is provisional. Consult the UA PDF for full rules text before play.

## Subclass Entry Point

- Fighters choose a subclass at **level 3**. A Fighter below level 3 does **not** yet have any Arcane Archer features — represent them as a preview/reference section clearly marked *"Unlocks at Level 3."*

---

## Progression

| Level | Feature |
|---|---|
| 3 | Arcane Archer Lore |
| 3 | Arcane Shot (2 options known) |
| 7 | Curving Shot · Ever Ready Shot · +1 Arcane Shot option |
| 10 | Improved Shots (die → d8) · +1 option |
| 15 | Powerful Shots (die → d10) · +1 option |
| 18 | Masterful Shots (die → d12) · +1 option |

**Options known by level:** 3 → 2 · 7 → 3 · 10 → 4 · 15 → 5 · 18 → 6.
Each time a new option is gained, one known option may be swapped out.

---

## Key Numbers

| Value | Formula / Detail |
|---|---|
| Spellcasting ability | **Intelligence** |
| Arcane Shot uses | = INT modifier (min. 1); recharge on **Short or Long Rest** |
| Arcane Shot save DC | **8 + INT modifier + Proficiency Bonus** |
| Arcane Shot damage die | d6 → d8 (L10) → d10 (L15) → d12 (L18) |

> Intelligence drives everything — DC, number of uses, and the bonus cantrip. A Fighter taking this subclass needs INT as a genuine secondary stat or the subclass is functionally inert.

---

## Core Features

- **Arcane Archer Lore (3)** — Learn *Druidcraft* **or** *Prestidigitation* (INT is the spellcasting ability). Gain proficiency in **Arcana** and **Nature**; if already proficient, substitute another skill of choice.
- **Arcane Shot (3)** — Once per turn, apply one known Arcane Shot option to a ranged attack made with an **Ammunition-property** weapon. Choose the option **after the hit lands and damage is dealt**, except for options that skip the attack roll entirely.
- **Curving Shot (7)** — On a **miss** with an Ammunition weapon, use a **Bonus Action** to attack a different visible target within long range that isn't behind Total Cover. Consumes no ammunition.
- **Ever Ready Shot (7)** — Rolling Initiative with **zero** Arcane Shot uses left restores **one**.

---

## Arcane Shot Options

Damage is expressed as "×1" or "×2" = one or two rolls of the Arcane Shot Die.

| Option | Damage | Save | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Banishing Shot** | Psychic ×1 | CHA | Incapacitated, Speed 0; returns at the end of its next turn. |
| **Beguiling Shot** | Psychic ×2 | WIS | Charmed by you or a chosen ally within 30 ft. until your next turn; breaks on damage or a forced save. |
| **Bursting Shot** | Force ×2 | — | Hits the target plus everything in a 10-ft. Emanation from it (no attack roll for the burst). |
| **Enfeebling Shot** | Necrotic ×2 | CON | Poisoned to the end of its next turn; its hits lose damage equal to one Arcane Shot Die roll. |
| **Grasping Shot** | Slashing ×1 | STR | Restrained until your next turn; escapable with Athletics vs. your DC. |
| **Piercing Shot** | Piercing ×2 | DEX | **No attack roll.** 30-ft. Line, 1 ft. wide, ignores cover; half damage on save. |
| **Seeking Shot** | Force ×2 | DEX | **No attack roll.** Curves to a creature seen in the last minute, ignores Half/Three-Quarters Cover; reveals its location; half on save. |
| **Shadow Shot** | Psychic ×1 | WIS | Blinded to the end of its next turn. |

---

## Build & Sheet Notes

- Short-rest recharge means uses can be spent freely in a single fight rather than hoarded across the day.
- **Piercing Shot** and **Seeking Shot** bypass the attack roll entirely — strong against high-AC targets or foes behind cover.
- **Ever Ready Shot** guarantees at least one charge entering every combat.
- The subclass requires an **Ammunition** weapon (longbow, shortbow, hand/light crossbow) to function.
- On a character sheet, present an Arcane Shot **use tracker** (pips = INT mod), the **save DC** and **die** as derived values, and each known/available option as a tooltip-backed card. For a pre-level-3 Fighter, render the whole block as a labelled preview section.
